added_lines: parish office or put into the collection bags at weekend masses. throughout november at every mass and on the first friday’s of every month we remember and pray for the repose of the souls of all the faithful departed. …………………. ‘indeed, the church in its pilgrim members, from the very earliest days of the christian religion, has honoured with great respect the memory of the dead; and “because it is a holy and wholesome thought to pray for the dead that they may be loosed from their sins ” (2mac 12:46) she offers her suffrages for them. these consist, primarily, in celebration of the holy sacrifice of the eucharist, and in other pious exercises, such as prayers for the dead, alms deeds, works of mercy, and the application of indulgences to the souls of the faithful departed. ’ directory on popular piety and the liturgy, 251 . norms for indulgences at the commemoration of all souls – by making confession within the week preceding or following 1st november, receiving holy communion and praying for the pope’s intentions (one our father & hail mary) when visiting a church or cemetery, one can gain a plenary indulgence for the holy souls of our dead. tree of memory in our church we have placed a tree of memory on which we placed the names of our parishioners who died and whose funerals were here in the parish in the past twelve months. everyone is invited to write the names of their loved ones who died elsewhere this past year and also place them on the branches. tags are available at the foot of the tree. also, if you wish simply to remember those who are part of your family tree and are now gone before us into god’s eternal merciful embrace, then please write their names and add them to our tree of memory. a special mass of memory with our choir, soloists and musicians will be celebrated on friday 6th november at 7:30pm in st. colmcille’s church. at this mass we will remember in particular parishioners whom we have buried since this time last year. we invite their families to join us for this memorial mass, as we recognise their grief and support them with our prayers. we also invite other parishioners who may have lost loved ones and celebrated their funerals elsewhere. please come and join with us as we pray for the gentle repose of their souls in the eternal love and mercy of god. kells
